三个任务：(1) SCP seed2 ckpt-3500 到 28034 如果不在，(2) 提交 eval 到 GPU 0，(3) 检查 seed1 ckpt-8000。

## 硬规则
**提交前必须验证目标 GPU VRAM < 1000 MiB：**
```bash
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -i 0
```
返回值 > 1000 → **禁止提交**。

## Part 1: 检查 + SCP seed2 ckpt-3500

先检查 28034 是否已有：
```bash
ssh westd-28034 "ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp003_s2/checkpoint-3500/adapter_model.safetensors 2>/dev/null && echo EXISTS || echo MISSING"
```

如果 MISSING，通过本地中转 SCP：
```bash
scp -r westd-29046:/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp003_r3only_seed2/checkpoint-3500/ /tmp/checkpoint-3500-s2/
ssh westd-28034 "mkdir -p /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp003_s2/checkpoint-3500/"
scp -r /tmp/checkpoint-3500-s2/* westd-28034:/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp003_s2/checkpoint-3500/
rm -rf /tmp/checkpoint-3500-s2/
```

验证：
```bash
ssh westd-28034 "wc -c /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp003_s2/checkpoint-3500/adapter_model.safetensors"
```
应 ~245MB。

## Part 2: 提交 eval 到 GPU 0

VRAM 预检后：
```bash
ssh westd-28034 "tmux new-session -d -s eval-s2-ckpt3500 'cd /root/contrastive_entrain_calib && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 /root/miniconda3/bin/python eval/eval_unified_preset.py --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen3-8B --lora_path /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp003_s2/checkpoint-3500 --data_path /root/mvp_v2_1_expanded/data/calibration_v2_1_expanded.jsonl --output_dir /root/contrastive_entrain_calib/results/exp003_d027_eval --exp_id exp003s2-ckpt3500'"
```

```bash
ssh westd-28034 "sleep 15 && nvidia-smi -i 0 && ps aux | grep exp003s2-ckpt3500 | grep -v grep"
```

## Part 3: 检查 29046 seed1 ckpt-8000

```bash
ssh westd-29046 "ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp003_r3only_seed1/checkpoint-8000/adapter_model.safetensors 2>/dev/null && echo 'CKPT8000_EXISTS' || echo 'CKPT8000_MISSING'"

```

```bash
ssh westd-28034 "mkdir -p /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp003/checkpoint-8000/"
scp -r /tmp/checkpoint-8000/* westd-28034:/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp003/checkpoint-8000/
rm -rf /tmp/checkpoint-8000/
ssh westd-28034 "wc -c /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp003/checkpoint-8000/adapter_model.safetensors"
```
